why: `[A, B]` is `horzcat(A, B)` (doc 'horzcat'). A concatenation with the object among its operands gives its class, or runs the class's own concatenation, or errors (MATLAB R2026a: `[k, 1]`, `horzcat(k, 1)`, `cat(2, k, 1)` and objects of two classes error): the call after it is reached with the object or not at all, so `tidy(k)` is `Gizmo::tidy` in every form (project rule, step 15 round 7).
